description: This file defines a set of logical formula classes (e.g., And, Or, Not, Always, Eventually) and related functions for constructing and manipulating temporal logic formulas. It also includes runtime setup, re-exports, and a State interface for application state management.

classes.name: Formula
classes.description: Base class for logical formulas with methods for logical operations.

classes.name: Pure
classes.description: Represents a boolean value with a pretty string representation.

classes.name: And
classes.description: Represents a logical AND of two formulas.

classes.name: Or
classes.description: Represents a logical OR of two formulas.

classes.name: Implies
classes.description: Represents an implication between two formulas.

classes.name: Not
classes.description: Represents the negation of a formula.

classes.name: Next
classes.description: Represents the 'next' temporal operator applied to a formula.

classes.name: Always
classes.description: Represents the 'always' temporal operator with optional time bound.

classes.name: Eventually
classes.description: Represents the 'eventually' temporal operator with optional time bound.

classes.name: Thunk
classes.description: Represents a deferred computation of a formula.

classes.name: State
classes.description: Interface describing the application state, including document, window, navigation history, errors, console, and last action.

classes.name: NavigationEntry
classes.description: Type representing a navigation history entry.

classes.name: ConsoleEntry
classes.description: Type representing a console log entry.

methods.name: not
methods.description: Creates a Not formula from an IntoFormula.

methods.name: now
methods.description: Converts an IntoFormula or boolean into a Formula, with support for deferred evaluation.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Creates a Next formula from an IntoFormula.

methods.name: always
methods.description: Creates an Always formula from an IntoFormula.

methods.name: eventually
methods.description: Creates an Eventually formula from an IntoFormula.

methods.name: extract
methods.description: Creates a Cell that extracts data from the runtime state based on a query function.
